author: SamFPlays

textNotes.text: ⚠️ PATCHED: some skips in this run no longer work. NEW post-patch 1.0.1 run (11 min) here 👉 https://youtu.be/WpvNjqVmpVM
Stuck on a skip? Step-by-step voice guide: https://youtu.be/1HqP4q2WERw

I cut 3 minutes off my Kuldra run. Full sub 10 min run in RuneScape: Dragonwilds with brand new tech: surge + phase dash skips, a soulscourge food trick, and a FULL elemental puzzle skip before it gets patched.
No commentary. Follow along step by step, or use the chapters to jump straight to the skip you need.
0:20 Windstep to air anima
0:40 Soulscourge skip (phase dash + food trick)
1:21 Skip the black dragon
1:38 Skip the ENTIRE necromancer area (2 windsteps)
2:34 Skip the ENTIRE poison area
3:04 Surge + phase dash past the abyssal demon
3:40 Skip the HARDEST part of the raid
5:21 Skip the ENTIRE elemental puzzle (before it's patched)
7:10 Skip the Kuldra fight in under a minute
- Soulscourge skip (0:40): eat food while holding E. Start holding E BEFORE you take damage or it'll stop you.
- Elemental puzzle skip (5:21): use it before it gets patched.
- Fleet Foot Infusion: MUST BRING. Cuts sprinting stamina cost by 50%.
What's your best Kuldra time? Drop it in the comments. And tell me which skip you didn't know about. If this saved you time, a like helps the channel a ton.
